THE PORTRAIT EDIT
ISSUE 02 / THE PROMPT ISSUE
STUDIO
136
STUDY 137
Black Off-Shoulder Knit & Leather Wrap Skirt
Rights check
Source: 25028.jpg
IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with long, wavy black hair
stands against a white backdrop. She wears a black
ribbed off-shoulder knit top with a row of purple buttons
down one sleeve, over a sheer printed mesh bodice. A
purple orchid sits at her throat. A distressed brown
leather wrap mini skirt with eyelet laces and a studded
hem completes the look. Her expression is calm and
direct. Soft, even studio light. Palette of black, plum,
and burnt brown. Edgy and textured, in the style of a
grunge editorial lookbook.
Edgy, textured, editorial
WORKING NOTES
- The off-shoulder knit and leather wrap skirt are the key
textures.
- Keep the orchid as a single accent for contrast.
Try this: Keep the orchid as a single accent.
